_comment: The focus of the daily brief (planning/signals-plan.md, planning/signals-phase1-design.md). scripts/signals/sections/focus.mjs reads this file every day and computes each measure for each build. kind: rollout (versionCodes + releases), incident (sentryIssue), experiment (the card's A/B block). Measure ids: rollout = playAnrRate, playUsers, sentryAnrUsers, posthogActive7d; incident = sentryIssueDaily; experiment = abArms. The owner sets the focus; endCondition says when it is done. The section gives numbers only, no verdict (the verdict is Phase 2).
